item.title: Mesh client build log - part 1
item.description: My goal with this project is to build a fully open-source Meshtastic/Meshcore compatible client that is more “rugged” than what is currently available on the market. If there is enough interest, I will consider manufacturing a few and getting CE etc. certification done. If you are interested, please join the mailing list below.
